ai_summary: Camlin Fine Sciences Limited has formally announced the planned cessation of Mr. Pradip Kanakia as an Independent Director, effective October 18, 2026, upon the completion of his five-year term. This is a routine governance disclosure reflecting a scheduled board change due to tenure limits. While the unusually early notification date (over two years in advance) is noteworthy, it provides ample time for the company to manage succession planning without indicating any immediate material impacts or red flags.
